opt.source: round-1 FT-2 summaries (2 models, g2 start)

run.source: G-0 engrad_fit a N^b (1-core EnGrad wall = core-h)

core_h_measured.note: total = label-level EnGrad core-h (counts against the G budget); MLTS optimisation GPU / wall reported separately (G4-cost)

decisions.G4-alloc: 1,000 reactions = 200 per round-1 fold model FT_k (k = 0..4, the --models order; FT_0 = FTpilot_<base>_0), drawn from that model's own training side: T1 fold != k (fold -1 anchor-only cores included), minus the reactions of its validation split (rxn_ids of <split_dir>/valid.xyz from results/ft/<model>_data.json, split must be fold<k>), minus the reactions that already have a label-level G2->label path (gen_dft G-2 plan, 400) or a Phase I G3L / Part B path (60), minus reactions already drawn for a smaller k (1,000 distinct reactions). Strata dipole x g1 class (C_compare same_ts_g1: same / different / none), 200 allocated proportionally to the stratum sizes of the remaining pool (largest remainder, ties in stratum order), uniform order inside a stratum with numpy default_rng(SEED + 400 + k). The pool is first restricted to reactions with a label TS and a start TS file (G2 start: 650 of 9,266 have none); a drawn reaction whose start atom order differs from the label TS is skipped and the next one in that stratum is taken.
decisions.G4-start: start = the G2 TS in label order ($G2/g2_final/<rxn>/ts.xyz; the deployment path starts from an xTB-level TS, so G-4 samples the MLTS PES where deployment walks; the label-start neighbourhood is already covered by G-1 ts_near / ts_imag). --start label is allowed and recorded in the plan; only reactions with a usable start are drawn (no fallback).
decisions.G4-opt: MLTS optimisation = ts_geom.evaluate_one (the FT-2 evaluator: mlts_bridge.optimize_ts, ORCA ExtOpt OptTS with the D1 OptTS block, MLIP initial Hessian, Recalc analytic:30, n_imag < -50 cm-1, |dd| / RMSD / same_ts against the label TS) with the round-1 model of the allocation; one MLTS server per model per task, W = CPUs - 2 ORCA workers.
decisions.G4-tight: TightOpt (DECISIONS A-1 '수렴 기준': MLTS optimisations use TightOpt): ts_geom.evaluate_one(tight=MLT_G4_TIGHT, default 'tight') (the same convergence as FT-2 / X since decision TSG-tight).
decisions.G4-errors: a python exception in one reaction is retried once in place; a second failure writes a status 'pipeline_error' record (no geometry) only while the MLTS server is alive: a dead server writes no error record and the task exits 1 (infra retry; the reactions stay to do); > 20 errors: no error records, exit 3.
decisions.G4-d0: D0 (user decision D0-plus: 'G-4에 D0 포함'): + 100 D0 reactions per round-1 model (500), the D0 training side = gen_d0 g2_pool_d0.json ranked units (G2c xTB TS in label order, label TS = the Coley G16 TS, user decision D0-gauss) minus every reaction of $MLT/dft/plan/d0_holdout.csv (evaluation + siblings; finetune drops their TS-derived rows anyway; the file must exist (else not ready, exit 2) and match g2_plan_d0.json holdout.sha256 (else STOP)), minus the D0G2 training units (g2_plan_d0.json rxns: they already have a label-level path), neutral only (charge1 + charge2 = 0: mlts_bridge.optimize_ts has no charge argument); strata = D0 class, largest remainder, default_rng(SEED + 450 + k); a D0 reaction belongs to every FT_k training side, so model k is only its optimiser. Records $MLT/g4/opt/k<k>_<model>/d0_<start>/recs/<d0_id>.json, EnGrad struct_id g4d0_<d0_id>; extxyz tags rxn_ids '' / folds '' / dipoles = the D0 class (FT_LODO_d drops class d), info d0_id / d0_class (finetune holdout rule by d0_id).
decisions.G4-geom: the EnGrad structure is the final MLTS geometry of status ok (converged) and not_converged (MaxIter) optimisations (rounded to 1e-6 A in the record); timeout / orca_error / pipeline_error / no_start and geometries with two atoms closer than 0.5 A get no EnGrad (counted).
decisions.G4-engrad: EnGrad = gen_dft.run_struct unchanged (mlt_common.orca_grad_input: the D1 'grad' keyword set, ORCA 6.1.1 serial, label-level input echo + SMD CDS + water epsilon checks -> $MLT/dft/STOP on a level mismatch, one rerun on failure), group G4, struct_id g4_<rxn_id>, kind al_ts, charge = label charge1 + charge2, multiplicity 1; slices = LPT on n_atoms^3 over the 1,000 planned reactions (gen_dft.slice_units), so the slices never depend on which optimisations finished.
decisions.G4-select: selection: max over atoms of |F_i| (per-atom force norm) > 0.002 Eh/bohr; the max |gradient component| is recorded too (count reported). Selected structures -> $MLT/dft/gen_G4.extxyz (mlt_common.ext_atoms: REF_energy eV, REF_forces eV/A), kind al_ts, source mlts_<start>_optts, tags rxn_ids / folds / dipoles of the reaction (finetune drops it from FT_<fold> and FT_LODO_<dipole>), dform_label_A = max |d - d_label| over the two label forming bonds (finetune TS-near rule), model / model_k / mlts_status / fmax_eh_bohr info.
decisions.G4-cost: predicted_core_h = sum over the planned reactions of the G-0 EnGrad fit a N^b (results/G0_estimate.json engrad_fit; an upper bound: every reaction with a geometry). core_h_measured.total = the label-level EnGrad core-h (all attempts) = what counts against the 5,000 core-h G budget; the MLTS optimisation cost (GPU s, wall) is reported separately (opt_*), not as DFT core-h.
decisions.G4-est: est.opt.unit_wall_h = median ts_geom wall per reaction of the g2 (else label) start from the round-1 FT-2 summaries of the listed models ($MLT/ft2/<model>/<start>/summary.json), else the FT2-p pilots, else Z_report geometry walls (median over candidates), else 300 s; workers 14. est.run.unit_wall_h = median a N^b (1-core EnGrad), workers 64.
